subjects.label: Missing game modes
subjects.description: Requests for modes the game lacks, such as a career or Become a Legend mode, Master League, and 11v11 or 2v2 and 3v3 matches; not how much there is to do in the modes it has.

subjects.label: Scripting and handicap
subjects.description: The belief that matches are rigged by hidden momentum or handicap so that luck or an AI-favoured opponent decides the result rather than skill; not ordinary difficulty settings or balance between teams.

subjects.label: Home clubs and leagues
subjects.description: Players asking where their own country's league, club or footballer is, why it is missing or half done, and cursing the exclusive licences that keep it out; not the overall count of real names or kits.

subjects.label: Logging in and connection
subjects.description: Getting online at all: login refused or the server always busy, being unable to connect after an update, playing offline because the connection fails, and the lag or cross-region matching once you are in; not co-op or the player count.

subjects.label: Earlier editions of the series
subjects.description: Comparing the game with its own earlier editions and the series it replaced, remembering the old ones fondly, wanting last year's version back or declaring the series finished; not comparisons with rival football games.

subjects.label: Player cards, coins and squad power
subjects.description: Building a squad from player cards bought with coins or handed out as bonuses, coin offers in the shop, and whether high-rated players win matches rather than skill; not the price of the game itself.

subjects.label: Launch state and the 1.0 relaunch
subjects.description: The bare state the game shipped in, features promised for launch and missing, waiting for a dated update or the 1.0 version, and dating a verdict to before or after a particular patch; not routine patch notes.

subjects.label: Divisions and events
subjects.description: The ranked division ladder and the timed events that structure play, climbing to a division and stopping, what happens once you reach a given division, and asking for more events; not matchmaking or server quality.

subjects.label: AI teammates and opponents
subjects.description: How computer-controlled footballers behave, teammates loitering behind defenders, a terrible CPU side, and how the game plays against the AI compared with against people; not the responsiveness of the player you control.
